rules.desc: 1 MR per Rs40 = 2.5 pts/Rs100 at Rs0.25/pt = 0.625% (cash/conservative).
3X MR on all spends in a currency other than INR = 7.5 pts/Rs100 at Rs0.25 = 1.875%. Forex markup 3.5% applies.

5 MR per Rs100 on fuel (petrol, diesel, CNG from OMCs), capped 5,000 pts/calendar month (official FAQ + MR Terms) = 1.25%, cap Rs1,250 at Rs0.25/pt. Fuel convenience fee (MITC): 0% at HPCL below Rs5,000, 1% at HPCL Rs5,000+, 1% (min Rs10) at BPCL/IOCL, 2.5% (min Rs10) at other pumps. At non-HPCL pumps the fee exceeds the reward.

5X MR on ShopWise e-vouchers = 12.5 pts/Rs100 at Rs0.25 = 3.125%. Amazon voucher purchases limited to Rs20,000/month per voucher type and carry 1.5%+GST convenience fee (ShopWise T&C); other vouchers may carry fees. Other earn caps not confirmed.

point_value_inr.note: Amex India does not publish a single rupee value per Membership Rewards point. Official Gold Card benefits calculator assumes Rs0.25 per point and says up to Rs0.56 per point via the Gold Collection (24,000 pts = Taj Rs14,000 / Tanishq or Tata CLiQ Rs9,000 / Amazon Rs8,000; 18,000 pts = Taj Rs9,000 / Amazon Rs6,000). Statement credit/Pay with Points value not published; Rs0.25 used as conservative.

cards.status_source: https://www.americanexpress.com/in/charge-cards/platinum-card/
cards.eligibility: Personal annual income Rs25L+ (employed) or Rs15L+ (self-employed); Indian/multinational bank account; resident in listed cities. Invite-level premium.
cards.notes: Fuel entry resolved: official FAQ and MR Terms both state 5 MR per Rs100 on Platinum Card fuel, capped at 5,000 points per calendar month (earlier sources conflicted 3,000 vs 5,000; official = 5,000). Fee Rs66,000+tax both years (page, Charge MITC Mar 31 2026, Schedule Aug 2025); 4 supplementary cards free then Rs10,000 each. Forex 3.5% currency conversion factor. 'Platinum Charge' = this same card. Official page notes hotel/flight booking desk unavailable until 15 Nov 2026 and Mumbai/Centurion lounge status not verified. 'No points on insurance and other utility services (household electricity, gas, water)'; EMI at merchant earns nothing. Rewards Xcelerator brands (10X/20X, Rolex/gold coins excluded at some partners) not modelled: caps unverified. Official card page banner (read 2026-10-11): 'We are temporarily pausing the acceptance of new card applications in India as we make planned updates to our technology platforms for domestic card issuing operations.' Applies to every personal card page. No jewellery/gold exclusion appears in the MITC or MR terms read (only fuel/insurance/utility/cash/EMI-at-POS style exclusions), but jewellery is not explicitly addressed: jewellery_unconfirmed. Amex may decline some merchants per offer T&Cs.

Jewel = Rs0.14 on statement credit/cash/bill pay, Rs0.20 on Jupiter flights/store/vouchers/gold => 7% / 10%. Caps (T&C, from 10-Oct-2026): 10,000 Jewels per cycle for the category (Rs1,400 cash / Rs2,000 best), 3,000 Jewels per merchant (Rs420 / Rs600), 1,000 Jewels per transaction (so max_txn_inr 2000 is the spend that earns full 50 Jewels). 5 Jewels/Rs100 credited instantly, remaining 45 at cycle end. cards.notes: CORRECTION: the '10% brand rate' is real but conditional and capped. Official T&C (jupiter.money/edge-csb-terms-conditions, versions to 9-Oct-2026 and from 10-Oct-2026): shopping brands (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata Cliq, Ajio, Nykaa, Croma, Reliance Digital, Trent/Tata Retail, Reliance Retail) earn 50% Jewels (=50 Jewels per Rs100) only when total qualifying spend in the statement cycle exceeds Rs15,000 (from 10-Oct-2026; before that unconditional), else 5% Jewels; Jupiter Flights 25%; everything else 5% Jewels; 'Others (Restricted)' MCCs earn nothing.
